BiblicalUsage: Moresheth-Gath is the prophet Micah's hometown, named in his lament over the cities of Judah. Thou shalt give presents to Moresheth-Gath, for the houses of Achzib shall be a lie to the kings of Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the prophet names his own town first in the judgment: the word of God begins at home.
